    def hasMySubordinate(self):
        return self._mySubordinate is not None

    def setMySubordinate(self, aNewMySubordinate):
        if self._mySubordinate is not None and self._mySubordinate is not aNewMySubordinate and self._mySubordinate.getMyDriver() is self:
            return False
        self._mySubordinate = aNewMySubordinate
        anOldMyDriver = aNewMySubordinate.getMyDriver() if aNewMySubordinate is not None else None

            if anOldMyDriver is not None:
                anOldMyDriver._mySubordinate = None
            if self._mySubordinate is not None:
                self._mySubordinate.setMyDriver(self)
        return True

    def delete(self):
        existingMySubordinate = self._mySubordinate
        self._mySubordinate = None
        if existingMySubordinate is not None:
            existingMySubordinate.delete()
